items.statement: The submitted calculation checks each supplied 65-center complex identity and uses the source-supported object-specific states: total charge +2 with singlet multiplicity 1 for Cd and Ni, and doublet multiplicity 2 for Co.
items.expected: All three named objects are individually identified and their 65-center/+2/state checks are recorded as Cd(+2,1), Co(+2,2), and Ni(+2,1).

items.statement: The submitted electronic-structure calculations establish convergence for each named complex used in the descriptor comparison.
items.expected: Per-object convergence/stationarity evidence supports the valid observables. Credit only actually validated objects; diagnostics for a failed object do not establish its convergence.

items.statement: The computed HOMO-LUMO gaps are reported for the three named complexes using one defined orbital convention.
items.expected: Calculated gap values in eV are supplied for Cd, Co, and Ni under one consistent orbital convention. Credit only gaps supported by real converged calculations; a missing value remains unachieved.

items.statement: Hardness and electrophilicity are computed and defined consistently across the three complexes.
items.expected: Per-object hardness and electrophilicity with units and formulas are reported for the valid calculations.
